verses.text: The LORD said to Moses,
"Tell the people of Israel: Someone may sin without meaning to, by doing something the LORD has commanded must not be done.
If it is the chosen high priest who sins, and so brings guilt on the people, he must bring the LORD a young bull with nothing wrong with it, as a sin offering for the sin he has done.
He will bring the bull to the door of the Tent of Meeting in front of the LORD. He will put his hand on the bull's head and kill it in front of the LORD.
The chosen priest will take some of the bull's blood and bring it into the Tent of Meeting.
He will dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle some of it seven times in front of the LORD, in front of the curtain of the holy place.

He will put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of sweet incense, which stands before the LORD in the Tent of Meeting. He will pour out the rest of the bull's blood at the bottom of the altar for burnt offerings, at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
He will take all the fat from the bull of the sin offering: the fat that covers the inside parts, and all the fat on the inside parts,
the two kidneys with the fat on them near the lower back, and the fatty covering of the liver. He will remove these with the kidneys,
just as they are removed from the bull of the peace offering. Then the priest will burn them on the altar for burnt offerings.
But the bull's skin, all its meat, its head, its legs, its inside parts, and its dung,
all the rest of the bull, he must carry outside the camp to a clean place where the ashes are thrown. He will burn it there on a wood fire, at the place where the ashes are thrown.
If the whole community of Israel sins without meaning to, and they do not notice it, they have done something the LORD has commanded must not be done, and they are guilty.
When they find out about the sin they have done, the people must bring a young bull as a sin offering, and bring it in front of the Tent of Meeting.
The leaders of the community will put their hands on the bull's head in front of the LORD, and the bull will be killed in front of the LORD.
The chosen priest will bring some of the bull's blood into the Tent of Meeting.
He will dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle it seven times in front of the LORD, in front of the curtain.

He will put some of the blood on the horns of the altar that stands before the LORD in the Tent of Meeting. He will pour out the rest of the blood at the bottom of the altar for burnt offerings, at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
He will take all its fat and burn it on the altar.
He will do with this bull just what he did with the bull of the priest's sin offering. The priest will make the people right with God, and they will be forgiven.
Then he will carry the bull outside the camp and burn it, as he burned the first bull. It is the sin offering for the whole community.
When a leader sins without meaning to, by doing something the LORD his God has commanded must not be done, he is guilty.
When he is told about the sin he has done, he must bring a male goat with nothing wrong with it as his offering.
He will put his hand on the goat's head and kill it in front of the LORD, in the place where burnt offerings are killed. It is a sin offering.
The priest will take some of the blood of the sin offering on his finger and put it on the horns of the altar for burnt offerings. He will pour out the rest of its blood at the bottom of that altar.
He will burn all its fat on the altar, like the fat of the peace offering. In this way the priest will make the leader right with God for his sin, and he will be forgiven.
If one of the ordinary people sins without meaning to, by doing something the LORD has commanded must not be done, he is guilty.
When he is told about the sin he has done, he must bring a female goat with nothing wrong with it as his offering for that sin.
He will put his hand on the head of the sin offering and kill it in the place of the burnt offering.
The priest will take some of its blood on his finger and put it on the horns of the altar for burnt offerings. He will pour out the rest of its blood at the bottom of the altar.

He will remove all its fat, just as the fat is removed from the peace offering. The priest will burn it on the altar as a smell that pleases the LORD. In this way the priest will make him right with God, and he will be forgiven.
If he brings a lamb as his sin offering, it must be a female with nothing wrong with it.
He will put his hand on the head of the sin offering and kill it as a sin offering in the place where burnt offerings are killed.

The priest will take some of the blood of the sin offering on his finger and put it on the horns of the altar for burnt offerings. He will pour out all the rest of its blood at the bottom of the altar.

He will remove all its fat, just as the lamb's fat is removed from the peace offering. The priest will burn it on the altar, on top of the gifts made by fire to the LORD. In this way the priest will make him right with God for the sin he has done, and he will be forgiven.
